'''Gettle Tebron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who competed as a professional [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] player during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Tebron was a member of the [[Shad Furies/Legends|Shad Furies]] shockball team and became a friend and rival of the [[Eriadu Patriots/Legends|Eriadu Patriots]] player [[Kob Mondray]]. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] Mondray and Tebron were both signed by the [[Kuat Artisans]] team and through their efforts they brought their team to the final round of the [[Galactic League/Legends|Galactic League]] in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]] where they lost to the [[Commenor Diamonds]]. Mondray and Tebron subsequently guided their team to victory in the Galactic League the [[25 BBY/Legends|following year]]. During the Clone Wars Kob Mondray sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and became a figurehead for the movement, and Tebron never spoke to Mondray again.
